description: As nhflow_3d_si_nh_curv_slosh_skew on a grid with curved lines (the interior nodes displaced by up to one cell, the walls straight), turned by 30 deg, on 2 ranks: the centres and the cell gradients of the cells of the neighbouring rank. With the second-order time levels of v52 the sum of eta^2 stays within 2 % over 136 periods (it fell by 12 % before).
covers: nh_curv_phi_corr: exchange of the fields of the cell gradients
